hooks.name: Commit Review Gate
hooks.description: At `git commit`, asks for the reviews the edit journal says the change needs: unsafe-reviewer for a rustconn-*-sys change, security-reviewer for credential code, uk-translation-reviewer for po/uk.po. Replaces three PostFileSave agent hooks that fired once per file — six loops for a six-file change to the secret subsystem, each seeing one file in isolation, plus one on every msgmerge rewrite of uk.po. Asks rather than blocks: it cannot observe whether a reviewer already ran. Scope is the agent's own writes, never the dirty tree. Fails open. Logic: bin/commit-review-gate.sh.
